fees.notes: AEU does not publish fees publicly. Contact university for current fee schedule. Financial aid available: PTPTN loan, EPF withdrawal, merit scholarship, 10% early settlement discount, 10% loyalty discount, 50% senior citizen discount, 75% disability discount.

requirements.direct_entry: STPM Grade C (GP 2.0) in two subjects AND pass in Mathematics and English at SPM; OR STAM Jayyid AND pass in Mathematics and English at SPM; OR Diploma/Advanced Diploma; OR Matriculation/Foundation CGPA 2.00; OR UEC Grade B in five subjects AND pass in Mathematics and English; OR other equivalent qualifications.
requirements.apel_entry: Minimum 21 years of age with relevant working experience.
requirements.english_requirement: IELTS 5.5 or equivalent for international students. MUET Band 3 for Malaysian students.
requirements.other_qualifications: UEC Grade B in five subjects accepted

program_name_zh: 工商管理学士（荣誉学位）
